comparison.objective: Sort wet-chemical and CO2 extinguishers to the correct hazards by reading type cards.
comparison.physical_skill: Identify, carry, and stand two extinguishers on separate marks.
comparison.success_condition: Each named extinguisher stands at its matching fire-risk location; detailed pose tolerances are not provided.
comparison.reason: This tests semantic identification and heavy-object placement, not tool-mediated adjustment or iterative physical-response tuning.
